Container.Name: Web-Check
Container.Overview:
Web-Check is an open-source OSINT tool for analysing websites and domains. It provides information about IP addresses, SSL certificates, DNS records, cookies, HTTP headers, domain information, crawl rules, redirects, open ports, traceroute, DNS security, performance, trackers, associated hostnames and other website intelligence.
Web-Check works without any API key for its core functionality. Optional API keys can be configured to enable additional checks and enrichment from external services.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Web-Check Web Check OSINT Website Security Reconnaissance Domain DNS SSL Shodan
Container.Requires: No special privileges are required. Optional API keys can be configured to enable additional checks and enrichment features.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Port used to access the Web-Check web interface.

Config.Name: Host
Config.Description: Network interface on which Web-Check listens. The default value is 0.0.0.0.

Config.Name: Google Cloud API Key
Config.Description: Optional Google Cloud API key used by Web-Check for additional checks.

Config.Name: Shodan API Key
Config.Description: Optional Shodan API key used by Web-Check for additional host and hostname information.

Config.Name: WhoAPI API Key
Config.Description: Optional WhoAPI key used by Web-Check for additional WHOIS information.

Config.Name: SecurityTrails API Key
Config.Description: Optional SecurityTrails API key used by Web-Check for additional domain and IP information.

Config.Name: URLScan API Key
Config.Description: Optional URLScan API key used by Web-Check for additional URL intelligence.

Config.Name: Cloudmersive API Key
Config.Description: Optional Cloudmersive API key used by Web-Check for additional security and threat intelligence checks.

Config.Name: Tranco Username
Config.Description: Optional Tranco username used for traffic ranking checks.

Config.Name: Tranco API Key
Config.Description: Optional Tranco API key used for traffic ranking checks.

Config.Name: Torrent IP API Key
Config.Description: Optional Torrent IP API key used for additional IP intelligence.

Config.Name: BuiltWith API Key
Config.Description: Optional BuiltWith API key used for additional website technology information.

Config.Name: API Rate Limit
Config.Description: Enable rate limiting for Web-Check API requests.

Config.Name: API Timeout
Config.Description: Maximum timeout for Web-Check API requests, in milliseconds.

Config.Name: API CORS Origin
Config.Description: Optional allowed origin for Web-Check API CORS requests.

Config.Name: Disabled Checks
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated list of Web-Check checks to disable.

Config.Name: Enabled Checks
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated list of checks to enable exclusively.

Config.Name: Blocked Hosts
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated list of hosts or networks that Web-Check must never scan.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Optional proxy trust configuration when Web-Check is running behind a reverse proxy such as Traefik or Nginx.
